let P := Equiv.Perm Nat
let Finitary := Subgroup.closure {s : P | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap s}
let conj := fun (s : P) => MulAut.conj s
let conjugate := fun (s : P) (S : Subgroup P) =>
  Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (conj s)) S
let blockSym := fun (S : Finset Nat) =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
let forward := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (p : P) (hp : conjugate p S ≤ T) =>
  MonoidHom.comp (Subgroup.inclusion hp)
    (MonoidHom.subgroupMap (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (conj p)) S)
let backward := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (p : P) (hp : T ≤ conjugate p S) =>
  MonoidHom.comp (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulEquiv.subgroupMap (conj p) S).symm)
    (Subgroup.inclusion hp)
let Mod := fun S : Subgroup P => ModuleCat.{v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex S)
let Res := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (f : S →* T) =>
  (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f).toRingHom :
    CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod T) (Mod S))
let Ind := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (f : S →* T) =>
  (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
      (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := S))
      (Rep.indFunctor Complex f))
    (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := T)) :
    CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod S) (Mod T))
∀ (K H G : Subgroup P) (α β : ↥Finitary)
  (X : Finset Nat) (g r c : Nat)
  (D : Fin g → Finset Nat) (A : Fin r → Finset Nat) (B : Fin c → Finset Nat),
  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (D i)) →
  (∀ a, Finset.Nonempty (A a)) →
  (∀ b, Finset.Nonempty (B b)) →
  Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)) →
  Pairwise (fun a a' => Disjoint (A a) (A a')) →
  Pairwise (fun b b' => Disjoint (B b) (B b')) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, n ∈ D i) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ a, n ∈ A a) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ b, n ∈ B b) →
  let Kα := conjugate (α : P) K
  let Hβ := conjugate (β : P) H
  G = iSup (fun i => blockSym (D i)) →
  Kα = iSup (fun a => blockSym (A a)) →
  Hβ = iSup (fun b => blockSym (B b)) →
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let left := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let right := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let Q := DoubleCoset.Quotient (left : Set G) (right : Set G)
    let rows := fun i : Fin g =>
      Finset.filter (fun a : Fin r => A a ⊆ D i) Finset.univ
    let cols := fun i : Fin g =>
      Finset.filter (fun b : Fin c => B b ⊆ D i) Finset.univ
    let row := fun (i : Fin g) (a : Fin (Finset.card (rows i))) =>
      Finset.subtype (fun n : Nat => n ∈ D i)
        (A ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin (rows i) rfl a).val))
    let col := fun (i : Fin g) (b : Fin (Finset.card (cols i))) =>
      Finset.subtype (fun n : Nat => n ∈ D i)
        (B ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin (cols i) rfl b).val))
    let Mat := fun i : Fin g =>
      {R : Fin (Finset.card (rows i)) → Fin (Finset.card (cols i)) → Nat //
        (∀ a, Finset.sum Finset.univ (R a) = Finset.card (row i a)) ∧
        (∀ b, Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun a => R a b) = Finset.card (col i b))}
    let J := ∀ i : Fin g, Mat i
    let rank := fun (i : Fin g) (S : Finset ↥(D i)) (x : ↥S) =>
      ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin S rfl).symm x).val
    let αmap : K →* G := forward (α : P) hK
    let βmap : H →* G := forward (β : P) hH
    ∃ (split : G ≃* (∀ i : Fin g, Equiv.Perm ↥(D i))) (classify : Q ≃ J) (σ : J → G),
      (∀ (s : G) (i : Fin g) (x : ↥(D i)), (split s i x).val = (s : P) x.val) ∧
      (∀ (s : G) (i : Fin g) a b,
        (classify (DoubleCoset.mk left right s) i).val a b =
          Finset.card (row i a ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding (split s i)) (col i b))) ∧
      (∀ R : J, DoubleCoset.mk left right (σ R) = classify.symm R) ∧
      (∀ (R : J) (i : Fin g) a b (x : ↥(row i a)) (y : ↥(col i b)),
        split (σ R) i y.val = x.val ↔
          ∃ k : Fin ((R i).val a b),
            rank i (row i a) x =
              Finset.sum (Finset.Iio b) (fun b' => (R i).val a b') + k.val ∧
            rank i (col i b) y =
              Finset.sum (Finset.Iio a) (fun a' => (R i).val a' b) + k.val) ∧
      let L := fun R : J => Kα ⊓ conjugate ((σ R : P) * (β : P)) H
      let lambdaMap : ∀ R : J, L R →* K := fun R =>
        backward (α : P) (show L R ≤ Kα from inf_le_left)
      let muMap : ∀ R : J, L R →* H := fun R =>
        backward ((σ R : P) * (β : P))
          (show L R ≤ conjugate ((σ R : P) * (β : P)) H from inf_le_right)
      (∀ R : J,
        L R = iSup (fun a => iSup (fun b =>
          blockSym (A a ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding (σ R : P)) (B b))))) ∧
      Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Ind βmap) (Res αmap))
        (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj
          (fun R : J => CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Res (muMap R)) (Ind (lambdaMap R))))) ∧
      ((∀ k : K, (αmap k : P) = (k : P)) →
        (∀ h : H, (βmap h : P) = (h : P)) →
        let T := fun R : J => conjugate (σ R : P)⁻¹ (L R)
        let transport : ∀ R : J, L R →* T R := fun R =>
          MonoidHom.subgroupMap
            (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (conj (σ R : P)⁻¹)) (L R)
        ∃ (hKG : K ≤ G) (hHG : H ≤ G) (hLK : ∀ R : J, L R ≤ K) (hTH : ∀ R : J, T R ≤ H),
          Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso
            (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
              (Ind (Subgroup.inclusion hHG)) (Res (Subgroup.inclusion hKG)))
            (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj (fun R : J =>
              CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
                (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
                  (Res (Subgroup.inclusion (hTH R))) (Res (transport R)))
                (Ind (Subgroup.inclusion (hLK R)))))))

The common finite carrier and its ordered partitions encode singleton padding for the ambient group and the two conjugated subgroups. The rank equations apply the ordered matching of Proposition 7.3 on each ambient block, including blocks with a single double coset. The two natural isomorphisms use the same matrix-indexed representatives and intersections. In the inclusion formula the pullback along conjugation by the inverse representative is written as its own restriction functor.
